_doc: Title-tour camera paths, authored with the camera path editor (Tools → 🎥 Camera path; its 'Copy JSON' output goes here). Keys are in geographic terms — lat / lon (EPSG:4326) and agl = metres above the ground — so a path survives changes of the map window, vertical exaggeration or the W↔E flip. lookAt: 'site' (always aim at the whole-site marker) or 'keys' (each key's own `look` target; via points borrow their neighbours'). style: 'smooth' (centripetal Catmull-Rom) or 'straight'. `via: true` marks a point that only bends the route. duration in seconds. Playback: constant speed along the path, eased start/stop, never below 20 m above the ground. paths.town = the opening flight from 'You are here' over the town hall and the sports complex up toward the plateau (if absent, the app's built-in flight is used).
